method: Six alternating pack CLI activations (real nested compositor reload/check), then three fresh full production-shell starts until Configuration Loaded, with 10 ms polling. Isolated IPC/XDG roots/private D-Bus. Baseline copies task-start source; new copies final source. Dependencies/assets/caches warm; this measures configuration loading, not first-pixel presentation or user-desktop startup. No network/device actions. Old service writes geometry; new writes colors only.
